response.answer: Prof. Ian Tattersall is a renowned paleoanthropologist known for his research on early human dispersals and migration patterns in western Europe during the Pleistocene. His work emphasizes the complexities of early human occupations and population dynamics. He has contributed significantly to the understanding of Neanderthals and early Homo sapiens.
